source_snapshot.criteria: Link off: Green off/Yellow off; link on with no activity: Green on/Yellow off; activity: Green blinking/Yellow off.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek correctly identifies physical visual acceptance but provides no port mapping, controlled stage method, timing evidence or management-access recovery.

original_test_intent.purpose: Visually verify the specified Mellanox management-LAN port's two-color LED behavior in three distinct network states: link absent, link established but idle, and active traffic.
original_test_intent.target: The exact physical green and yellow indicators belonging to the owner-identified management-LAN port on one verified SUT/NIC configuration.
original_test_intent.scope: One observation per required state: both LEDs off with link off; green steady and yellow off with an idle link; green blinking and yellow off during activity. Software link/counter data can corroborate but cannot replace visual color/blink evidence.
original_test_intent.operation: Safely stage the exact port through link-off, link-up idle and controlled traffic while an authorized operator observes and records the physical LEDs, then restore normal management connectivity.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The workbook estimates 10 attended and 10 machine minutes; it defines three states once each and no repeat count or blink-frequency requirement.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Each staged network state produces exactly the green/yellow behavior listed in the Criteria, with the tested port and state proven at the observation timestamp.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Port/SUT/NIC/BMC identity and physical map; stage method and timestamps; operator photos/video showing both LEDs for each state; synchronized link/traffic corroboration; management restoration and exceptions.
ambiguities: The exact physical port and its relation to BMC versus host management traffic are not identified.
No blink frequency, stabilization time or controlled traffic method is defined.
The safe method for producing link off without losing the only management path is absent.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly preserves the physical visual criterion, all three source states, port mapping, corroborating-only software data, safe link staging and independent recovery. Its classification and central contract are technically sound.

applicable_history.decision: V2 formalizes DeepSeek's NO as MANUAL ONLY because no authoritative automated substitute exists for the physical color/blink observation. No contrary user decision was found.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep V2. The three physical LED observations remain the acceptance criterion and require a qualified observer. Automated switch/traffic control or software telemetry may support staging and time correlation but does not change the MANUAL ONLY classification.

available_now: All three expected green/yellow state combinations are explicit.
Read-only interface identity, link state, counters and management-path topology can be collected before physical staging.
missing_inputs: The NIC/platform owner must identify the exact management-LAN port and LED pair and supply any stabilization/blink tolerance.
The lab/network owner must supply a safe link-off and controlled-activity method, an authorized observer/camera, an independent recovery path and approval for management disruption.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The NIC/platform owner supplies port/LED mapping and tolerances; the lab/network owner supplies topology, staging, observer and recovery authorization.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Record SUT/NIC/BMC/interface/switch-port mapping and baseline link/counter state.
Photograph the labeled physical port without changing link state and verify an independent management/recovery path.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not disconnect or disable the management path without recovery, infer LED state from counters, observe another port, generate uncontrolled traffic, repeatedly flap the link, clear logs or let an agent claim visual PASS.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Approve the exact port map and staging plan, synchronize visual and link/traffic evidence for each of the three states, compare both colors with the source table, and prove normal management connectivity is restored.

revision_candidate.test_name: Mellanox Management-LAN Green/Yellow LED State Check
revision_candidate.purpose: Visually verify the exact management-LAN port's green and yellow LEDs during link-off, link-up idle and controlled activity states.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The server/NIC/BMC/switch topology whose physical management-LAN port and LED pair are confirmed by the product map, with an observer at the chassis and an independent recovery path.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One owner-identified physical port and both of its LEDs through the three source-defined states, once each. Software status is corroborating evidence only.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Port/LED map; expected state table; any timing tolerance; isolated/safe link and traffic method; SUT/NIC/BMC/switch identities; operator/camera; independent console/recovery path; disruption approval; evidence storage.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Record baseline and exact port. Stage link off and capture Green off/Yellow off. Restore link without intentional traffic, wait the approved stabilization interval and capture Green steady/Yellow off. Generate bounded traffic on that exact port and capture Green blinking/Yellow off. Correlate optional link/counter evidence, stop traffic and restore the normal link.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct port/LED mapping verified; observer and synchronized camera ready; staging does not remove the only recovery path; traffic is bounded; affected users are clear; normal-state restoration is defined.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Physical map and identities; expected table; stage method/timestamps; photos/video showing both LEDs and labels for all three states; synchronized link/traffic context; operator observations; restored link/reachability; mismatch details.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The source Criteria for Wistron-HW-00394-V002, supplemented only by the exact product port map and owner-approved stabilization/blink tolerances.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not remove the sole management/recovery path, flap unrelated ports, use uncontrolled production traffic, change persistent network configuration, infer colors/blink from software, clear logs or expose credentials.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: A qualified operator must visually judge/capture the LEDs. The network/lab owner must approve link interruption and traffic staging on the mapped port.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The operator owns physical identification and visual color/blink acceptance. An agent may collect interface/counter evidence and control an approved fixture, but cannot replace the visual verdict.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: After each disruptive stage, restore the approved normal link. On lost management access, wrong-port action or unstable link, stop further flaps and use the independent console/switch recovery path while preserving evidence.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong/ambiguous port or LED; no independent recovery; uncontrolled traffic; lost access; unsafe topology; ambiguous color/blink or timing; missing visual evidence; unexpected network configuration change; or failure to restore normal link.

identified_defects: The source omits exact port/LED mapping, state-staging method, timing tolerance and recovery path.
DeepSeek lacks stage-specific evidence and recovery controls.
reason_for_change: No V2 semantic change is warranted; V3 records the same correct manual boundary with explicit readiness ownership and stage completion conditions.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-HW-00394-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: The criteria explicitly define three physical green/yellow combinations and no software-only acceptance method.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Port identity, blink/stabilization tolerance and safe staging topology remain owner-specific.

removed_ambiguities: Separates physical visual acceptance from software corroboration.
Binds each observation to one of three source-defined states and the exact mapped port.
Makes link restoration part of safe completion, not the LED verdict itself.
remaining_blockers: Execution requires physical mapping, observer/camera, safe staging and recovery inputs; these are readiness needs, not a semantic BLOCKED classification.
objective_improvement_over_v2: The correct V2 conclusion is preserved. V3 adds an auditable distinction between manual acceptance and automatable stage support without claiming that telemetry can see LED color or blink.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Isolated validation confirmed one exact physical management-LAN port and both LEDs across link-off, link-up-idle and bounded-activity states, owner-supplied platform LED semantics, human visual evidence, exact port/traffic mapping, independent recovery, disruption approval, full restoration, and no PASS from software counters or partial visual states.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Functionality row 1761 defines green/yellow LED outcomes for link-off, link-up idle and activity on a Mellanox management-LAN port.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 preserves the exact three states and correctly prevents software telemetry from replacing visual evidence.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Require an observer and independent recovery; permit automated corroboration/staging support but no automated visual verdict.
